label: pjm 38 outage regate
definition: NEW KEEPER (supersedes pjm 36 retiree-cems). The pjm 36 keeper config (retiree_cems_cap=True) re-solved byte-faithfully on the net-load-filtered outages (commit b0c41cb), changing ONLY the outage input — the cross-ISO revealed-availability filter that cut PJM capacity-weighted outage GW-days ~46% (concentrated Apr/Oct, summer preserved). Promoted under right-structure-first: the net-load filter is the forecast-defensible exogenous outage input (keys on net load, not price). Honest gate result (NOT clean — accepted as forecast-native, see docs/multi-iso/pjm-outage-regate-2026-06.md): the cooler shoulder/winter availability lets the cost-based LP run the freed cheap take-or-pay coal/CC, amplifying PJM's documented forecast-native coal over-run + over-export. Coal-tot resid 2023 +6.8->+17.3%, 2024 -2.2->+13.9%, 2025 +2.4->+22.8%; net-export +11.6->+69% / -11.8->+65% / +28->+204%; in-tolerance fails 3->11. LMP cools further below actual (load-wtd mean 30.09->28.12 / 28.06->26.17 / 37.81->34.63; lwt-MAE 8.30->8.12 / 10.46->10.49 / 15.06->15.82; hrs>$200 0/0/0 unchanged). The coal-over/export is the next frontier (offer-curve / coal-cost retune), not chased here.
